subject: Re: Intro to Redwood Inference — demo next steps

From: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha@fintechco.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Date: 2025-09-10T13:15:00Z
Subject: Thanks for the chat — proposed demo times

Hi Samantha —

Thanks for taking the time today — really helpful to understand FinTechCo's latency-sensitive fraud scoring pipeline and the multi-tenant constraints you mentioned. Quick recap:

- Primary goal: reduce inference cost while meeting 100ms p99 for short completion requests.
- Key stakeholders: Rajiv (platform/CTO) + engineering (integration owners).
- Important constraints: SOC 2 evidence, on-prem option for EU customers later this year.

Next step: a 30-min product demo + technical deep dive to show: runtime behavior on streaming workloads, batching/kv-cache examples, and routing/fallback policies. I can do a 30-min session next week — would any of these work for you and the team?

Option A: Tue Sep 16, 11:00–11:30 AM PT
Option B: Wed Sep 17, 2:00–2:30 PM PT
Option C: Thu Sep 18, 9:00–9:30 AM PT

If none of those fit, here is my Calendly: https://calendly.com/redwood-demo/30min — feel free to pick a time and I’ll send an invite.

Agenda I’ll send if you confirm (short demo, 10–12 mins technical deep dive, Q&A). I’ve attached short discovery notes from today and a suggested agenda. Please also let me know which internal folks you want on the call (CTO, SE, engineering manager).

Thanks — looking forward to continuing the conversation.

Best,
Alex Martinez
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
alex@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0132
